summary: Medium batch (8 items) tested end-to-end. All 12 backend tests pass (100%), all frontend selectors verified live in Preview. Intent Gateway fix 1 (agentic-verb-anywhere override) works and all 3 regression cases still classify as query. critical_code_review_comments: backend/scripts/ci_check_raw_exception_leak.py: sink list is intentionally narrow (only `_log`, `_emit_step`, assigns to `ora_reply`/`error_plain`/`user_message`) — this is documented and correct for now but future user-facing sinks (e.g. new `_task_step`, `_notify_customer`) must be added to _SINK_CALL_NAMES or leaks will slip through. Consider a comment marker convention (`# customer-facing-sink`) that the linter could pick up.

backend/services/dora_metrics.py: change_failure_rate loop does N sequential per-deploy Mongo count_documents queries (2 per deploy). Fine at current scale but a single `$facet` aggregation or bulk window scan would be O(1) queries — flag if deploy counts ever exceed a few hundred per period.
